description: Add ReturnValues.as and ReturnValues.expected. description: Implement ASParser in AppScript/ASParser.h and AppScript/ASParser.m. The parser consumes the token stream produced by ASLexer and produces an array of top-level AST nodes (class and category definitions). Parse all language constructs per ARCHITECTURE.md: @class declarations with superclass and optional protocol list, @category declarations, @property declarations with optional modifiers, instance and class method definitions with infix selector syntax, variable declarations (id, weak id, constant id), message sends (including multi-keyword selectors), block literals (^{ } and ^(args) { }), return statements, string/number/array/dictionary/nil/bool/selector literals. The parser must produce actionable error messages with line numbers for syntax errors. All public methods need /// DocC comments. Create ASParserTests.m with comprehensive unit tests.

description: AppScript currently cannot express negative number literals. A developer writing -3.14 gets a parse error because the minus token is consumed as punctuation and not followed by a method declaration. The fix is to handle a leading minus token in the parser's parseExpression method when it is immediately followed by a number literal token, folding the sign into the ASNumberLiteralNode value. Also update ARCHITECTURE.md to document the syntax, add unit tests for parser and lexer, and add a harness script NegativeNumbers.appscript.
title: Support unary - for negative number literals

description: Extend or replace Arithmetic.as/Arithmetic.expected to cover all four arithmetic operations: numberByAdding:, numberBySubtracting:, numberByMultiplyingBy:, numberByDividingBy:. title: Harness test: complete arithmetic operations

description: Implement ASRuntimeInstaller in AppScript/ASRuntimeInstaller.h and AppScript/ASRuntimeInstaller.m. description: installSentinelForMethodNode:onClass: and the category path both use ASTypeEncodingForParamCount (all-id encoding) when calling class_addMethod/class_replaceMethod. If the selector is declared in a protocol adopted by the class (or its superclasses), the sentinel should use the protocol's type encoding instead. This allows AppScript methods implementing protocol methods with primitive return types (e.g. BOOL) to be installed with the correct ObjC type encoding. Implementation: (1) extract ASProtocolTypeEncodingForSelector (const char * variant) from ASProtocolMethodSignatureForSelector, (2) use it in both installSentinelForMethodNode:onClass: and the category install path, (3) update ARCHITECTURE.md to document this behaviour, (4) add unit tests. Per CODING_STANDARDS the ARCHITECTURE.md update must be in the same commit as the code change.
title: Use protocol type encoding for sentinel IMP registration

description: Implement control flow categories. NSObject+AppScriptControlFlow in AppScript/NSObject+AppScriptControlFlow.h/.m: add - (id)do:(id (^)(void))aBlock while:(id (^)(void))testBlock (runs aBlock while testBlock returns non-nil/non-NO, may not run aBlock at all) and - (id)do:(id (^)(void))aBlock until:(id (^)(void))testBlock (runs aBlock until testBlock returns nil or NO, guaranteed to run at least once). description: ASBoxer.m's ASBoxBytes function has no case for '#' (the ObjC type encoding for Class).
